method.name: Recognize
method.description: Prerequisite for Transfer : the method Transfer is called on a starting object only if Recognize has returned True on it This allows to define a list of Actors, each one processing a definite kind of data TransferProcess calls Recognize on each one before calling Transfer. But even if Recognize has returned True, Transfer can reject by returning a Null Binder (afterwards rejection), the next actor is then invoked

method.name: Transferring
method.description: Specific action of Transfer. The Result is stored in the returned Binder, or a Null Handle for "No result" (Default defined as doing nothing; should be deferred) "mutable" allows the Actor to record intermediate information, in addition to those of TransferProcess

method.name: TransientResult
method.description: Prepares and Returns a Binder for a Transient Result Returns a Null Handle if <res> is itself Null

method.name: NullResult
method.description: Returns a Binder for No Result, i.e. a Null Handle

method.name: SetLast
method.description: If <mode> is True, commands an Actor to be set at the end of the list of Actors (see SetNext) If it is False (creation default), each add Actor is set at the beginning of the list This allows to define default Actors (which are Last)

method.name: SetNext
method.description: Defines a Next Actor : it can then be asked to work if <me> produces no result for a given type of Object. If Next is already set and is not "Last", calls SetNext on it. If Next defined and "Last", the new actor is added before it in the list

method.name: Next
method.description: Returns the Actor defined as Next, or a Null Handle
